The Face of the Games

"Bullied at primary school for being 'such a scraggy little thing', she started training not to be pushed around."

What motivated Sandra to take up sport?
A Her size.
B Her father's ambition.
C Her will to win.
D Her financial situation.

The Face of the Games

"The amazing thing about Sandra is that it didn't appear to affect her."

How did she feel about being the face of the Games?
A It inspired her.
B She felt it a strain.
C She ignored it.
D It didn't bother her.

The Face of the Games

"I do know that it has justified the many years of hard training I'd put in for that moment."

How does she feel about winning Olympic gold?
A Elated.
B Exhausted.
C Confused.
D Justified.

The Face of the Games

"I had proved to myself that I was the best in the world. It made all the years of self-sacrifice worthwhile."

She says she won gold for…
A her country.
B her parents.
C her trainer.
D herself.

The Face of the Games

"I had constant arguments with my trainer and we ended up having couples counselling – it was the closest I got to walking out on everything."

Her main problem earlier in her career concerned…
A finances.
B her parents.
C injury.
D her trainer.

The Face of the Games

"I've a sort of grim determination that I've inherited from my father."

She attributes her mental strength to…
A her father.
B her trainer.
C her socio-economic background.
D her skin colour.

The Online School

"Philip and his mates are making paper aeroplanes like schoolboys down the ages. (19) ___. And they're not fooling around. They're studying physics and aeronautics."

A Others say that their computer is an invaluable home tutor.
B However, most students do not think that computers will ever replace teachers.
C There have been computers around for as long as they can remember.
D Nevertheless, students appreciate things the computer can help them do.
E Here they can borrow books, do last-minute homework or sit at the computers.
F There's no other way they could have got such up-to-date information.
G The only difference is that these boys are being given design tips by a computer.
